input.command:
cat > $TMPDIR/geo.py <<'EOF'
import glob,re,collections,os
rows=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/r2run-5wzagmdg/data/text/*.txt')):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    # split on recommendation forms
    parts=re.split(r'=== page \d+',t)
    for p in parts:
        if 'Case Number' not in p: continue
        m=re.search(r'Damage Location:[ \t]*(.*)',p)
        c=re.search(r'Case Number:[ \t]*(\S+)',p)
        rows.append((os.path.basename(f),c.group(1) if c else None,m.group(1).strip() if m else None))
print('cases',len(rows))
print('no DL',sum(1 for r in rows if r[2] is None))
for r in rows:
    if r[2] is None or ',' not in r[2] or r[2].split(',')[-1].strip()=='' : print('ODD',r)
cities=collections.Counter()
withc=0
for r in rows:
    if not r[2] or ',' not in r[2]: continue
    city=r[2].split(',')[-1].strip().lower()
    if not city: continue
    withc+=1; cities[city]+=1
print('with city',withc)
for c,n in cities.most_common(40): print(n,repr(c))
top5=sum(n for _,n in cities.most_common(5))
print('top5',top5, round(100*top5/withc,1))
EOF
python3 -I $TMPDIR/geo.py
